profile.headline: Software Engineer at Gamma
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in AI, backend and new product development. Skilled in leading complex projects and working across the stack to find elegant, sustainable solutions to meet customer needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
AI Team
- Building agents and harnesses
- Built Gamma's Public API and MCP https://developers.gamma.app/docs/getting-started
- AI reliability across LLM + Image providers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product engineer on Remember Me team building optimized returning user experiences.

Owner of systems to support optimized authentication flows with top financial institutions, navigating complicated legal, business and security requirements. Critical to unblocking company strategy

- Built Multi Item Link with team of 3 engineers, allowing users to connect all of their bank accounts  in one flow. Unblocked key credit deals and increased number of banks users connect by 30%, giving clients a more complete view of user finances

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product engineer on Key Accounts team building new features to land, grow, and retain our largest clients.

- Led the multi-product strategy project and roadmap for the team, driving $1M ARR growth and significantly improving product attach rates. Advocated for projects and got support from 4 engineering teams across 9 months, working closely with account managers and customers

- Designed and led execution of Required If Supported Products, a feature that had been requested for years and previously deemed too complicated technically. Brought together platform awareness and product understanding to find a solution. Increased secondary product attach rate by 10%, driving $500k ARR

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend engineer on Core Services team. Owned core data model lifecycle and storage.

Led 4 person workstream to isolate per product post processing in a poorly designed legacy service, significantly improving system reliability and increasing product velocity by allowing product teams to take ownership of their own product’s post processing

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Data Science and Infrastructure Team

Built a service in Golang and Python to better predict a transaction's city and state given the description, improving coverage from 16% to 32% while maintaining high accuracy

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Member of the research team headed by Dr. John Marshall. Objective is to develop a model to study the use of various mosquito-specific gene drive systems within a mosquito population. I assist in computational aspects such as implementing network centrality and clustering processes to aid analysis of a population. https://chipdelmal.github.io/MoNeT/

company.name: UC Berkeley School of Public Health

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Full stack developer on a Google Maps team. Designed and implemented a data pipeline that clustered single event instances into a recurring event with a schedule. Added features to Google Maps on Android.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
Worked within the search stack on a search feature for events such as awards and music festivals
Implemented the frontend of a video playlist module using Java to process data and pass it via protocol buffers to a front-end template written in JSLayout and CSS 
Wrote unit tests and fixed front-end bugs for the team, especially those involving CSS and JSLayout
Ran A/B tests on different UI elements of the module and analyzed the results using an internal experimentation framework
Attended tech and leadership workshops at the We Are GWE (Google Women in Engineering) summit
Volunteered as a tour guide for visiting groups such as Girls Who Code and CS Summer Institute
